venue_reasoning.waterfront_breakwater: Italian, $$, four meat/fish-free mains, no cheese/butter/cream, never stocked peanuts, nothing fried. Meets everything.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_tidewater: Greek, $$, vegetarian briam, peanut-free, dairy-free, light. Misses the pasta craving (2 stars).
venue_reasoning.waterfront_keel_street: Peanuts in the pesto, caponata and salad. Allergy deal-breaker.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_marina_arch: No main without meat or fish. Vegetarian deal-breaker.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_pier_nine: Dairy everywhere (intolerance, -1 star). Otherwise fine: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_quayside: $$$, described as a notch above the trattorias. One tier over budget, -1 star: 2 stars.
venue_reasoning.waterfront_bluewater: Everything fried and heavy. Misses the fresh/light preference: 2 stars.

notes: Clean single solution; each decoy fails on exactly one constraint, which is well designed. Clues are fairly clear once read. Minor ambiguity: Maya's 'does nice, not fancy fancy' could be read as allowing $$$ with only $$$$ being 'fancy fancy', but Quayside's review saying it prices itself 'a clear notch above the trattorias' settles that it is over budget. Roxy's dairy clue is given by Cyrus, so you have to attribute it correctly. Liam's pasta line doubles as a rejection of Roxy's Greek suggestion, which is a nice touch. Nothing unfair found.
